# Independent expectations: exact blueprint presentation

This oracle is prepared before implementation. It is a development fixture, not
generator input, a visible Field document, or evidence that any test has passed.
It complements `EXPECTED.md`; the declared synthetic identities, evidence coverage,
representative selection and topology remain intact. Synthetic reading stubs must
not be relabeled as real paper analyses. No test is run by preparing this file.

## Sole blueprint and matching boundary

The sole presentation blueprint is `5-templates/模范知识库`, specifically its domain
overview and the `3dgs高频表面表示` and `3dgs模型优化` topics as inspected before this
implementation. Other formal libraries, test outputs, installed defaults and the
current helper are not alternative presentation authorities.

Required blueprint structure, view roles, card composition, navigation and default
appearance must match, rather than being approximately similar. Do not omit an
existing responsibility because another representation looks sufficient. Do not
add a default directory, view, navigation section or card responsibility absent from the
blueprint. Preserve the blueprint's observed variants instead of manufacturing one
uniform variant.

Fixed expectations are file and column responsibilities, semantic hierarchy, visual
treatment and link presentation. They are not quotas on claims, explanation depth,
figures, tables, evidence, papers or branches, nor a source of scientific facts.
Required format slots remain required; research content within them follows the
actual topic and existing `analyze-paper` requirements. Use real figures and evidence
when needed, without adding material to match the blueprint's count or deleting
necessary arguments, figures, tables or evidence because the example has fewer.
Its authors, topic names, IDs, paths, claims and source verdicts belong to its examples;
a new domain receives its own supplied content.

Navigation follows the applicable observed variant, not a universal link quota.
Preserve different overview, view and paper navigation arrangements; do not force
every page to link every graph or add empty shortcuts for symmetry.

## Domain, topic and paper structure

A normal complete domain has a `README.md` overview with topic navigation. Each
topic retains four distinct slots and its own paper units:

```text
<domain>/README.md
<domain>/<topic>/01-论文列表.md
<domain>/<topic>/02-文献树.canvas
<domain>/<topic>/03-技术路线树.md
<domain>/<topic>/03-技术路线树.canvas
<domain>/<topic>/04-挑战洞见树.md
<domain>/<topic>/04-挑战洞见树.canvas
<domain>/<topic>/resources/<paper>/Paper.md
<domain>/<topic>/resources/<paper>/<paper>分析.md
<domain>/<topic>/resources/<paper>/<paper>解析树.canvas
```

The normal paper unit includes a genuine readable analysis and editable paper
analysis Canvas alongside `Paper.md`. Missing real analysis is an explicit gap,
not permission to invent placeholder analysis, fake Canvas content or completion.
The existing synthetic fixture's intentionally supplied reading stubs remain stubs.

The blueprint places paper directories directly under `resources/`; it does not
insert an extra `papers/` layer. Existing analysis figures and their replay records
live in that paper's `attachments/`, only when actually used. They are single-paper
attachments, not another domain view or a default empty directory. Existing
`.scholar-workflow` metadata is preserved where present, not promoted to a new human
navigation surface. The blueprint has no separate topic `README.md` default.

### The two observed 02 Markdown variants

- The high-frequency topic has `02-文献树.md` with detailed changes, tradeoffs,
  relation explanations and evidence. Its Canvas explanation links point there.
- The model-optimization topic has no `02-文献树.md`; its Canvas explanations link
  directly to the relevant source or existing analysis. Its other required views
  and navigation remain present.

Both are exact observed variants. A new topic declares the appropriate variant;
do not add an empty 02 Markdown solely for filename symmetry. Preserve an existing
02 Markdown and its human content and links. Removing one requires an explicit
removal request and conservation of its content and inbound navigation, not merely
selection of the no-companion variant. An omitted companion never excuses a lost
explanation or unusable detail/source link.

## Content and navigation responsibilities

- The domain overview links into topics and their four views. 01 is the complete
  paper list, with the five columns `论文资料`, `年份与发表`, `研究线索`,
  `原 PDF · ZotFlow`, `分析与图示`. Complete publication metadata belongs here or
  in `Paper.md`, not in extra diagnostic columns or timeline title rows.
- 02 is a horizontal literature spine with important branches and local follow-ups
  below it. Preserve its selected papers, supported roles, relation explanations,
  title, legend and necessary relation labels. A paper title is a plain linked
  short name plus compact year or year/month, not a Markdown heading. An adjacent
  separate explanation gives the change and relevant tradeoff/condition, with a
  detail/source link. Do not append full first-preprint dates, venues, extra source
  rows or execution status to the title card.
- 03 expands from the central research goal through routes to individual papers,
  with branches on both sides and aligned peer layers. Route cards contain a short
  explanation and paired-prose link. Each paper leaf contains a linked heading,
  one specific method sentence, and available analysis, paper-Canvas and original
  navigation; the heading itself opens the paper's `Paper.md`.
- 04 expands from the central goal through specific problems and solution nodes
  to individual papers. Solution nodes carry how it works, conditions and limits;
  the paper leaves use the same compact composition as 03. Detailed evidence and
  comparison belong in the solution explanation or paired prose, not repeated
  input/gain/cost/limitation paragraphs inside every paper leaf.
- `Paper.md` carries the full paper title, return links to 01 and the domain overview,
  original/project/record actions, analysis and notes, supported related-work links,
  and bibliography. A timeline-position entry is present where applicable. Source
  notes remain linked, not copied into the analysis or manufactured as a new default
  directory. PDFs remain at their actual provider; no copied PDF is required here.
- Preserve every declared semantic node, selected paper occurrence, owner, role,
  source and required relation. A representative 02 selection does not erase papers
  from 01 or other required views. Repeated challenge occurrences share their paper
  owner but retain separate leaves. Paper count is supplied by the new domain.
- Keep evidence at the corresponding factual statement or relation explanation,
  with its original/detail action at the same discussion point. General bibliography
  alone does not replace evidence for a specific claim. Compact Canvas summaries
  retain usable original/detail navigation and their corresponding readable prose.

## Availability and absence of development extras

Use one readable statement in 01 or an existing reachable coverage section for a
shared missing-analysis state. Do not create a new default ledger file or repeat
the same long warning in every card. Preserve item-specific abstract-only coverage,
unknown methods and missing originals in their list rows or paper records, with a
short leaf indication where a source action would otherwise mislead. Existing real
analyses remain linked; absent analyses never gain fabricated notes or buttons.

The human Field tree contains its overview, topic views, paper records, genuine
analyses and required human-readable source material. Test plans, acceptance logs,
machine inputs and execution diagnostics stay in the development workspace. Do not
add `_输入`, `_验收`, a parallel `资料` hierarchy, copied test instructions or this
oracle as research navigation. Do not remove existing human content merely to make
an existing topic look like a new one.

## Default size, style and native fit

Use the blueprint's default widths: 02 paper titles are 300–350px, with 300px for a
short title; radial roots, routes, problems and solutions are 340px; radial paper
leaves are 370px. Preserve the separate timeline title/description composition.
Heights adapt to the full rendered text and spare click space; neither the observed
58px title height nor the observed 200/220px leaf heights are fixed bounds. Do not
truncate text, grow unrelated cards uniformly or hide required navigation to fit.

This iteration defaults to the blueprint's appearance: white background, hidden
grid, no node shadow, blue timeline milestones, green important branches, brown
local links, softly colored radial branches and white detail cards. A requested
theme may change concrete colors; do not silently substitute a new palette here.
Use scoped role styling from the actual `scholar-literature-tree.css` and
`scholar-mind-map.css`, not styling that changes unrelated Canvas views.

The default timeline title is 22px, description text 19px and description links
16px; its display heading is 40px and labels/legend 17px. Radial body text is 18px,
h1 is 25px and h2 is 21px. Connections use short horizontal/vertical square paths,
no arrows, rounded square bends, crossings or text occlusion; invisible junctions
are layout aids, not semantic content. The inspected Advanced Canvas presentation
settings are `edgesStylingFeatureEnabled=true`,
`defaultEdgeStyleAttributes.pathfindingMethod=square`, and
`edgeStyleSquarePathRounded=false`.

Native acceptance inspects actual computed heading/link sizes, padding and rendered
content. A container font declaration alone does not prove its headings match.
Every card must expose all text and its final link without scrolling to reveal
clipped content, with approximately one rendered text line of usable spare click
space beneath the last content. Long CJK/Latin labels may wrap and increase height.

## Bounded positive and negative cases

| Case | Expected positive result | Failure example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| New domain | Domain overview, four distinct topic slots and the real paper units use new supplied identities and links | Copying blueprint authors, paper quota, source IDs or topic paths; omitting an overview or view |
| Content quantities | Real research and existing analysis requirements determine explanation depth and figure/table/evidence/paper/branch counts within the required format | Padding to match the example's counts or removing necessary content because the example has less |
| Navigation variants | Each applicable observed navigation arrangement remains usable | Forcing every page to link all graphs or adding empty shortcuts for symmetry |
| 02 with companion | Existing detailed Markdown, explanations and inbound links remain intact | Deleting the companion to save a file or replacing its evidence with a generic source list |
| 02 without companion | Explanations reach the actual source/analysis and all other slots remain | Adding an empty or duplicated 02 Markdown solely for symmetry |
| Short timeline title | A plain linked short name plus compact year label uses the 300px default and adjacent explanation | Adding an h2, venue, full date and a separate source row inside the title |
| Distinct identities | A supplied short disambiguator preserves each paper's correct owner | Shortening makes distinct papers share an identity or attachment |
| Radial paper leaf | A 370px leaf has linked heading, one concrete method sentence and usable navigation | Repeating conditions/costs inside each leaf, adding modules, or removing source actions |
| Common missing analysis | An existing reachable section honestly states the gap once; real material/source links remain | Repeated per-card diagnostic paragraphs, a new default status file, or fabricated analyses |
| One missing original | That paper visibly retains its source gap and available web/record actions | Hiding the exception in a general paragraph or borrowing another paper's PDF |
| Different evidence coverage | Supplied full-fragment, abstract-only and unknown coverage remain distinguishable | Inventing method facts for an unknown item or treating an abstract as full-paper support |
| Required repeated occurrence | Distinct required leaves link the same paper owner | Deduplication removes a challenge occurrence or alters topology |
| Long mixed-language text | Full CJK/Latin text wraps and gains enough height and click room within the default width profile | Reusing a 58px height, clipping, ellipsis or adding metadata to compensate for bad sizing |
| Source destination | Long URLs, query strings and parentheses remain byte-preserved; labels wrap | Break characters alter targets, hidden destinations become extra prose, or links disappear |
| Evidence and explanation | The corresponding claim/relation retains evidence and accessible detail at that point | Moving all evidence to a remote bibliography or duplicating the same limitation paragraph |
| Paper attachments | Existing used figures stay with their genuine paper analysis | Creating empty attachments or a domain-level figure/replay view by default |
| Human tree | Only the blueprint responsibilities and required research material appear | Test plans, machine-input files, acceptance directories or parallel material hierarchies appear |

Geometry/schema checks do not establish native font size, click space or navigation.
Human review remains pending until the user confirms the affected appearance and
representative detail/source clicks. Structural completion does not establish
scientific support, full-paper analysis or installed-product acceptance.
